features.d: Your ceramist is in the building. Shade is matched in person and adjustments happen the same day.
Intraoral scanners and facial photography replace impressions. You see the design before any tooth is prepared.
One patient per room, with a window. Your coordinator stays with you between steps.
Low-dose imaging on site, read by your doctor during Visit 1.
Hospital-grade sterilization, with instrument pouches opened in front of you.
English and Spanish at every step, from the first message to delivery.

travel: Hotels within 10 minutes: we send a short list with your estimate
Uber and Lyft pick-ups at the front door
